title: Bandwidth sensitivity and RDD robustness checks

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy

We will use a Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD) to estimate the causal effect of index membership on institutional ownership. The key assumption of RDD is that there is a sharp discontinuity in the probability of treatment at the cutoff point, and that the running variable is as good as randomly assigned around the cutoff. We will test the robustness of the RDD estimate to different bandwidth choices, polynomial orders, and placebo cutoffs.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(rdrobust)

# Read the data
data <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s29_data.csv")

# Define a function to run RDD analysis with different bandwidths and polynomial orders
run_rdd <- function(data, bandwidth, order) {
  # Fit the RDD model
  model <- rdd::rdreg(y ~ running_var | treated, data = data, c = 0.5, h = bandwidth, order = order)
  
  # Extract the coefficient estimate for the treatment effect
  coef <- coef(model)[2]
  
  # Return the coefficient estimate
  return(coef)
}

# Run RDD analysis with different bandwidths and polynomial orders
bandwidths <- c(0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3)
orders <- c(1, 2, 3, 4)

# Store the results
results <- data.frame(bandwidth = numeric(), order = numeric(), coef = numeric())

for (bw in bandwidths) {
  for (ord in orders) {
    coef <- run_rdd(data, bw, ord)
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(bandwidth = bw, order = ord, coef = coef))
  }
}

# Print the results
print(results)

# Plot the results
ggplot(results, aes(x = as.factor(order), y = coef, color = as.factor(bandwidth))) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~bandwidth, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "RDD Coefficient Estimates by Bandwidth and Polynomial Order", x = "Polynomial Order", y = "Coefficient Estimate")
```

## 3. Expected Findings

We expect the coefficient estimates to be positive, as index membership is likely to increase institutional ownership due to increased visibility and demand. The magnitude of the effect may vary depending on the bandwidth and polynomial order, but we expect the estimates to be relatively stable across different specifications. The robustness checks will help us assess the sensitivity of the RDD estimate to different bandwidth choices and polynomial orders, as well as the validity of the placebo cutoffs.
